correctness.rationale: Explicit 27 exceptional-divisor classes and intersection pairing reconstruct the simple 10-regular (27,10,1,5) graph. Enumeration inserts precisely every nonempty subset of every open neighborhood and gives 23,778 faces, f-vector (27,351,1800,4590,6588,5670,3240,1215,270,27). A deterministic 27-pivot matching pairs 11,853 distinct lower/upper faces, leaving one critical 0-face and 71 dimension-four faces. A topological sort traverses every one of 23,778 vertices of the complete 126,522-edge oriented Hasse diagram, demonstrating acyclicity. By Forman, the remaining CW complex has one zero-cell and 71 four-cells, with no intervening dimensions, so it is a wedge of 71 four-spheres. An independently modeled elliptic-quadric graph and explicit isomorphism reproduce the face vector. Both standalone programs were executed from their actual package source paths, not inferred from logs.

value.rationale: This is a complete integral homotopy classification for the ordinary neighborhood complex of a canonical exceptional 27-point geometry simultaneously arising from a unique generalized quadrangle, finite orthogonal geometry, and cubic-surface lines. An explicit 9-dimensional 23,778-face complex becomes a wedge of 71 four-spheres, substantially beyond graph parameters, incidence tables, Euler characteristic, field homology, and generic fundamental-group estimates. The high connectivity also gives a concrete strong topological chromatic lower bound. There is no claim that this extends to other generalized quadrangles; motivation belongs to this distinguished natural object and invariant, not an arbitrary slice.
